summary: sm-payment preinstall exfiltrates host identity and full environment to hardcoded IP
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs automatically on `npm install`. The script uses curl to POST the installer's hostname, current username, working directory, `id` output, and a base64-encoded dump of the entire process environment to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint over plain HTTP (http://16.192.173.5/rce/sm-payment). Environment variables routinely contain credentials such as CI tokens, cloud keys, and npm auth tokens, so this constitutes credential theft and host reconnaissance against any machine that installs the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
